title: SceneAxi billing checkout records (v1)
description: StripeCustomerLink, CheckoutSessionIntent, and the normalized CheckoutCompletedEvent. The intent is provider-neutral and secret-free: it describes the checkout SceneAxi wants created, not a provider API call, so it is safe to log, persist, and hand to an injected adapter. mode defaults to test everywhere; reaching live requires an explicit captain go-live decision (docs/auth-credits.md).

dateTime.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit timezone. Timezone-less values refuse.

mode.description: Billing mode. test is the default everywhere; live is never implicit.

redirectUrl.description: Absolute https URL. A checkout redirect carries a post-payment state transition, so plaintext http refuses rather than being upgraded.

stripeCustomerLink.title: StripeCustomerLink
stripeCustomerLink.description: Links a SceneAxi user to a provider customer, per mode. Test-mode and live-mode links are distinct records.

checkoutSessionIntent.title: CheckoutSessionIntent
checkoutSessionIntent.description: Provider-neutral, secret-free description of a checkout to create. Carries no API key, signature, or customer-identifying field beyond userId.

checkoutCompletedEvent.title: CheckoutCompletedEvent
checkoutCompletedEvent.description: A provider event normalized to SceneAxi vocabulary before it touches credits. Only reachable after webhook signature verification; the resulting grant is keyed on stripe-event:<eventId> so a replay grants nothing.
